The file has a literal BOM character, which is what the test needs, and it passes.

The bug is fixed. A BOM at the start of a document no longer breaks block sequences like `cba:\n  - Xyz`. After the fix, the core test run shows 306 passed, 0 failed and 1 skipped. That run includes the new BOM test.

**Cause:** the parser skips a leading BOM by advancing `state.position` but left `state.lineStart` at 0. Every indentation calculation on the first line was then off by one, so block-sequence handling misjudged the indent of the `cba:` entry.

**Fix:** in `src/parser/parser.ts`, `state.lineStart` is now set to the new position right after the BOM is skipped.

**Test:** I added `test/core/bom.test.mjs`, which parses the reporter's BOM-prefixed YAML. I didn't run it against the unfixed parser, so I haven't confirmed it fails without the fix.
